units.rawText: Our gathered wishes have become the stars in the sky, and our star-questing sorcerer has brought them back to the mortal world, gifting us with blessings and heartfelt intentions.
units.displayText: Our gathered wishes have become the stars in the sky, and our star-questing sorcerer has brought them back to the mortal world, gifting us with blessings and heartfelt intentions.

spans.text: Our gathered wishes have become the stars in the sky, and our star-questing sorcerer has brought them back to the mortal world, gifting us with blessings and heartfelt intentions.

units.rawText: Hubble slowly lands near the Christmas tree and winks to Choco.
units.displayText: Hubble slowly lands near the Christmas tree and winks to Choco.

spans.text: Hubble slowly lands near the Christmas tree and winks to Choco.

units.rawText: Of course, there's a certain confectioner who helped us bring the stars down to earth.
units.displayText: Of course, there's a certain confectioner who helped us bring the stars down to earth.

spans.text: Of course, there's a certain confectioner who helped us bring the stars down to earth.

units.rawText: Ka-click. Before Choco can react, the spotlights are now shining on her.
units.displayText: Ka-click. Before Choco can react, the spotlights are now shining on her.

spans.text: Ka-click. Before Choco can react, the spotlights are now shining on her.

units.rawText: Undine looks at Choco and Hubble, and then at the audience before her. She studies these people who were once unfamiliar to her or whom she was once on guard against.
units.displayText: Undine looks at Choco and Hubble, and then at the audience before her. She studies these people who were once unfamiliar to her or whom she was once on guard against.

spans.text: Undine looks at Choco and Hubble, and then at the audience before her. She studies these people who were once unfamiliar to her or whom she was once on guard against.

units.rawText: And now, I'd like to share a message from the Reindeer Ensemble.
units.displayText: And now, I'd like to share a message from the Reindeer Ensemble.

spans.text: And now, I'd like to share a message from the Reindeer Ensemble.

units.rawText: Thank you, everyone.
units.displayText: Thank you, everyone.

spans.text: Thank you, everyone.

units.rawText: Undine bows deeply to the gathered Dolls.
units.displayText: Undine bows deeply to the gathered Dolls.

spans.text: Undine bows deeply to the gathered Dolls.

units.rawText: Thank you. Thank you for accepting us and letting the Oasis become our home.
units.displayText: Thank you. Thank you for accepting us and letting the Oasis become our home.

spans.text: Thank you. Thank you for accepting us and letting the Oasis become our home.

units.rawText: I'm grateful that we met here. I'm grateful that we've gotten to know each other, and I'm grateful for the time we spent together.
units.displayText: I'm grateful that we met here. I'm grateful that we've gotten to know each other, and I'm grateful for the time we spent together.

spans.text: I'm grateful that we met here. I'm grateful that we've gotten to know each other, and I'm grateful for the time we spent together.

units.rawText: Therefore, I'd like to sing <color=orange>"We Wish You A Merry Christmas"</color> with you to show our gratitude for the year we've spent together, and to welcome the new one.
units.displayText: Therefore, I'd like to sing "We Wish You A Merry Christmas" with you to show our gratitude for the year we've spent together, and to welcome the new one.

spans.text: Therefore, I'd like to sing
"We Wish You A Merry Christmas"
with you to show our gratitude for the year we've spent together, and to welcome the new one.

units.rawText: Ethereal and regal music fills the air.
units.displayText: Ethereal and regal music fills the air.

spans.text: Ethereal and regal music fills the air.

units.rawText: Ah, Angela taught us this song before!
units.displayText: Ah, Angela taught us this song before!

spans.text: Ah, Angela taught us this song before!

units.rawText: You've got to have this song for Christmas!
units.displayText: You've got to have this song for Christmas!

spans.text: You've got to have this song for Christmas!

units.rawText: Where's Nanaka? I want a clean recording!
units.displayText: Where's Nanaka? I want a clean recording!

spans.text: Where's Nanaka? I want a clean recording!

units.rawText: The gifts, the gingerbread men, and everyone's wishes blend in with Undine's performance, and the Dolls lose themselves in the festive spirit.
units.displayText: The gifts, the gingerbread men, and everyone's wishes blend in with Undine's performance, and the Dolls lose themselves in the festive spirit.

spans.text: The gifts, the gingerbread men, and everyone's wishes blend in with Undine's performance, and the Dolls lose themselves in the festive spirit.

units.rawText: Whew... looks like another peaceful Christmas.
units.displayText: Whew... looks like another peaceful Christmas.

spans.text: Whew... looks like another peaceful Christmas.

units.rawText: As I watch the Dolls enjoy the gingerbread men and have fun on the plaza, I can't help but sigh in relief.
units.displayText: As I watch the Dolls enjoy the gingerbread men and have fun on the plaza, I can't help but sigh in relief.

spans.text: As I watch the Dolls enjoy the gingerbread men and have fun on the plaza, I can't help but sigh in relief.

units.rawText: ...Although this is nothing like the original program that was planned.
units.displayText: ...Although this is nothing like the original program that was planned.

spans.text: ...Although this is nothing like the original program that was planned.

units.rawText: Just as gathered wishes rise to fill the starry skies, the stars become shooting stars and bring everyone a surprise.
units.displayText: Just as gathered wishes rise to fill the starry skies, the stars become shooting stars and bring everyone a surprise.

spans.text: Just as gathered wishes rise to fill the starry skies, the stars become shooting stars and bring everyone a surprise.

units.rawText: While this might be different from how the Christmas star was supposed to convey everyone's wishes, this sparkling starry night has its own unique flavor to it.
units.displayText: While this might be different from how the Christmas star was supposed to convey everyone's wishes, this sparkling starry night has its own unique flavor to it.

spans.text: While this might be different from how the Christmas star was supposed to convey everyone's wishes, this sparkling starry night has its own unique flavor to it.

units.rawText: Hm? What are you doing here, Hubble?
units.displayText: Hm? What are you doing here, Hubble?

spans.text: Hm? What are you doing here, Hubble?

units.rawText: You asked me to hand stars out to everyone, Professor.
units.displayText: You asked me to hand stars out to everyone, Professor.

spans.text: You asked me to hand stars out to everyone, Professor.

units.rawText: Naturally, that would include you, too.
units.displayText: Naturally, that would include you, too.

spans.text: Naturally, that would include you, too.

units.rawText: Hubble produces a uniquely-wrapped pouch from her broom's saddlebags.
units.displayText: Hubble produces a uniquely-wrapped pouch from her broom's saddlebags.

spans.text: Hubble produces a uniquely-wrapped pouch from her broom's saddlebags.

units.rawText: This is your star, Professor.
units.displayText: This is your star, Professor.

spans.text: This is your star, Professor.

units.rawText: When did you...
units.displayText: When did you...

spans.text: When did you...

units.rawText: Hehehe, it wasn't my work alone. Everyone in the Oasis made it for you.
units.displayText: Hehehe, it wasn't my work alone. Everyone in the Oasis made it for you.

spans.text: Hehehe, it wasn't my work alone. Everyone in the Oasis made it for you.

units.rawText: Well, what can I say?
units.displayText: Well, what can I say?

spans.text: Well, what can I say?

units.rawText: I open the box and find a gingerbread cookie that looks just like me.
units.displayText: I open the box and find a gingerbread cookie that looks just like me.

spans.text: I open the box and find a gingerbread cookie that looks just like me.

units.rawText: They say gingerbread men were originally made in the form of honored guests, as a surprise from the host.
units.displayText: They say gingerbread men were originally made in the form of honored guests, as a surprise from the host.

spans.text: They say gingerbread men were originally made in the form of honored guests, as a surprise from the host.

units.rawText: And it's also said that gingerbread cookies carry the wishes of people, conveying gratitude and wishes to those whom you treasure.
units.displayText: And it's also said that gingerbread cookies carry the wishes of people, conveying gratitude and wishes to those whom you treasure.

spans.text: And it's also said that gingerbread cookies carry the wishes of people, conveying gratitude and wishes to those whom you treasure.

units.rawText: This piece is the Wishing Gingerbread Cookie we all made for you. We hope you like it, Professor.
units.displayText: This piece is the Wishing Gingerbread Cookie we all made for you. We hope you like it, Professor.

spans.text: This piece is the Wishing Gingerbread Cookie we all made for you. We hope you like it, Professor.

units.rawText: How could I not like a gift that you made?
units.displayText: How could I not like a gift that you made?

spans.text: How could I not like a gift that you made?

units.rawText: I take the gingerbread cookie from the box, and slowly crunch it in my mouth...
units.displayText: I take the gingerbread cookie from the box, and slowly crunch it in my mouth...

spans.text: I take the gingerbread cookie from the box, and slowly crunch it in my mouth...

units.rawText: <color=orange><size=40>Merry Christmas, Professor/Commander/Boss/Chief/Master!</size></color>
units.displayText: Merry Christmas, Professor/Commander/Boss/Chief/Master!

spans.text: Merry Christmas, Professor/Commander/Boss/Chief/Master!
